detail.transcript: I had a really long day at work today and I keep replaying that conversation with my manager in my head.
detail.reply: It sounds like your mind is still spinning from the conversation. Did it feel like there was something unresolved, or did it just feel heavy to process?

detail.transcript: I don't really know why I've been feeling so flat this week. Nothing is wrong exactly, it just all feels like effort.
detail.reply: It sounds like you're carrying a lot without realizing it. What’s one small thing you’ve been avoiding lately?

detail.transcript: I finally finished the thing I had been putting off for a month and I feel a lot lighter than I expected to.
detail.reply: That sounds like a big win. Did you feel proud when it was done, or was there something unexpected about how it made you feel?

detail.transcript: My sister called and we ended up arguing about the same thing we always argue about, and I hung up feeling like the bad guy.
detail.reply: It sounds like the argument felt familiar and frustrating. Did you feel like you were trying to explain yourself, or did the conversation feel like it went in circles?

detail.transcript: I have been sleeping badly for about two weeks now and I think it is making everything feel harder than it actually is.
detail.reply: It sounds like the lack of sleep is really weighing on you. Are you finding it hard to focus or stay motivated during the day?

detail.transcript: I cried in the bathroom at work today and I genuinely do not know what set it off.
detail.reply: It’s strange how something can feel so heavy without a clear reason. Did anything feel unresolved or familiar about the moment you cried?

detail.transcript: My grandmother died last month and I still cannot talk about it without completely losing it.
detail.reply: It’s hard to hold onto things when the world feels too loud. Did you find a way to be with the memories without the pain?

detail.transcript: I got the promotion I wanted and instead of being happy I just feel like they are going to work out I cannot do it.
detail.reply: You wanted the promotion, but now you're worried about whether you can handle it. That’s a lot to carry. What’s the part that feels hardest to imagine succeeding at?

detail.transcript: I have been so lonely since I moved here. I go whole weekends without speaking to anybody.
detail.reply: It sounds like loneliness has been heavy lately. Did you find any small moments that made you feel less alone, even if just for a little while?

detail.transcript: I said something unkind to my partner last night and I have been sitting with how it landed ever since.
detail.reply: It sounds like the weight of your words is still heavy. Did you feel any shift in the space between you after saying it?

detail.transcript: Work has been brutal. I missed a deadline and my boss was furious and I do not think I handled it well.
detail.reply: It sounds like the pressure really got to you. Did you feel like you had support at work when things went wrong?

detail.transcript: I keep starting things and abandoning them halfway and I am starting to think that is just who I am.
detail.reply: It’s hard to feel like you’re stuck in a loop of starting and leaving things. Did you ever feel like something changed after you stopped a project or idea?

detail.transcript: My friend told me she is moving abroad and I am happy for her and also quietly devastated.
detail.reply: It’s strange how happiness and devastation can live side by side. Did you feel like you were losing something even though you’re happy for her?

detail.transcript: I went for a long walk this evening without my phone and it is the calmest I have felt in weeks.
detail.reply: That sounds like a moment of peace. Did the walk take you somewhere you hadn’t been before?

detail.transcript: I am so angry at my brother I could scream, and I know if I call him I will say something I regret.
detail.reply: It’s heavy carrying that anger alone. You feel trapped between wanting to lash out and knowing it will hurt. What’s the last thing you said to him that felt like a line in the sand?

detail.transcript: I have been pretending I am fine at work for about three months and I am tired of the performance.
detail.reply: It sounds like you've been carrying a lot for a while. Are you thinking about how to start being honest with yourself or others?

detail.transcript: My therapist is on leave for a month and I did not realise how much I had been leaning on those sessions.
detail.reply: It’s surprising how much you relied on those sessions. Did you feel a shift in your mood after they left?

detail.transcript: I turned thirty last week and I keep doing this thing where I audit my whole life against where I thought I would be.
detail.reply: It’s easy to feel like you’re falling short when you’re comparing your life to expectations. Did you ever feel like you had a moment where things started to shift, even if you didn’t notice it at the time?

detail.transcript: Someone I barely know was really kind to me today and it almost undid me, which feels embarrassing to admit.
detail.reply: It’s surprising how small acts can shake you. Did that kindness feel like a gift or a burden?

detail.transcript: I have been avoiding my inbox for four days and the avoiding is now worse than whatever is in there.
detail.reply: It sounds like the inbox has become a source of stress. Did you check it today, or did you let it build up again?

detail.transcript: My landlord is selling the flat and I have to move again and I am so tired of not having somewhere that is mine.
detail.reply: It sounds really heavy to keep moving. Are you feeling like you're losing control over your space and your life?

detail.transcript: I had a good day. Nothing special happened. I just want to say that out loud because it has been a while.
detail.reply: It’s nice to hear that. Sometimes just acknowledging a simple day can feel like a victory. What made today feel good, even if it wasn’t dramatic?

detail.transcript: I keep comparing myself to people I went to university with and it is making me miserable and I cannot stop.
detail.reply: It sounds like these comparisons are taking a toll. Do you ever feel like you're missing out on something important?

detail.transcript: My dad and I spoke properly for the first time in about two years and I do not know what to do with the feeling.
detail.reply: It’s strange how silence can feel like a weight, and then suddenly, it lifts. Did you say anything that felt like a step forward, even if it was small?
